title: A gate whose option names a local mirror store of an executor is classed push and made blocking
goal: A gate that says a local mirror store, a directory an executor keeps its own copy of a queue in, is not classed push: the push words stay for a write to a shared branch or a public copy, so the worker's provisional gate on an implementation choice is not made blocking by the word mirror alone

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import bl_authority as a; g={"id": "g9", "question": "How does an executor keep its jobs?", "options": ["a local mirror store of its own", "the central store directly"]}; sys.exit(0 if a.derived_class({"touches": ["_tools/kj_exec.py"]}, g) != "push" else 1)

notes: Met again by ST-ma2tluug: a provisional gate whose option read 'through a mirror store and LocalRemote, as a central queue's executor does' was classed push and made blocking (gate add printed: class push, matched 'mirror').
